title: Lior and the House
author: Zephyrine Fairweather
blurb: Gideon Crane, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
